* EapSimAkaUnsupportedAttributeException is thrown when an unsupported {@link EapSimAkaAttribute} * is attempted to be decoded. * *

Attributes are supported or not supported per the EAP method being used. For example, an * {@link AtVersionList} attribute would be considered "supported" when decoded from an EAP-SIM * context, but would be considered "unsupported" from an EAP-AKA context.
